SubLayerProcessing.SQLScript: SELECT DISTINCT XR.ICD AS condition_code, IC.CodeType AS condition_code_type, IY.EffectiveYear AS condition_effective_year, HC.hccNumber AS hcc_code, HC.hccVersion AS hcc_model_version, HC.hccType AS hcc_model_type, HY.EffectiveYear AS hcc_effective_year, XR.isPrimary AS is_primary_diagnosis, XR.EffectiveDateStart AS effective_start_date, XR.EffectiveDateEnd AS effective_end_date, hash(concat(IfNull(XR.ICD, ' '), '| ', IfNull(IC.CodeType, ' '), '| ', IfNull(IY.EffectiveYear, ' '), '| ', IfNull(HC.hccNumber, ' '), '| ', IfNull(HC.hccVersion, ' '), '| ', IfNull(HC.hccType, ' '), '| ', IfNull(HY.EffectiveYear, ' '), '| ', IfNull(XR.IsPrimary, false), '| ', IfNull(XR.EffectiveDateStart, ' '), '| ', IfNull(XR.EffectiveDateEnd, ' '))) AS icd_hcc_key FROM HCCICDDatasetXref XR JOIN ICDDataset IC ON IC.ICDDatasetID = XR.ICDDatasetID JOIN ICDEffectiveYear IY ON IC.ICDEffectiveYearID = IY.ICDEffectiveYearID JOIN HCCDataset HC ON XR.HCCDatasetID = HC.HCCDatasetID AND UPPER(HC.HCCType) IN ('COMM', 'ESRD') JOIN HCCEffectiveYear HY ON HC.HCCEffectiveYearID = HY.HCCEffectiveYearID ORDER BY condition_code, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, hcc_code
SubLayerProcessing.MergeScript: MERGE INTO claimsprocessing.gold.gold_icdhccxref t USING (SELECT * FROM tempSQLScript) s ON IfNull(s.condition_code, ' ') = IfNull(t.condition_code, ' ') AND IfNull(s.condition_code_type, ' ') = IfNull(t.condition_code_type, ' ') AND IfNull(s.condition_effective_year, ' ') = IfNull(t.condition_effective_year, ' ') AND IfNull(s.hcc_code, ' ') = IfNull(t.hcc_code, ' ') AND IfNull(s.hcc_model_version, ' ') = IfNull(t.hcc_model_version, ' ') AND IfNull(s.hcc_model_type, ' ') = IfNull(t.hcc_model_type, ' ') AND IfNull(s.hcc_effective_year, ' ') = IfNull(t.hcc_effective_year, ' ') AND IfNull(s.effective_start_date, ' ') = IfNull(t.effective_start_date, ' ') AND IfNull(s.effective_end_date, ' ') = IfNull(t.effective_end_date, ' ') WHEN MATCHED AND t.icd_hcc_key <> s.icd_hcc_key THEN UPDATE SET icd_hcc_key = s.icd_hcc_key, condition_code = s.condition_code, condition_code_type = s.condition_code_type, condition_effective_year = s.condition_effective_year, hcc_code = s.hcc_code, hcc_model_version = s.hcc_model_version, hcc_model_type = s.hcc_model_type, hcc_effective_year = s.hcc_effective_year, effective_start_date = s.effective_start_date, effective_end_date = s.effective_end_date, is_primary_diagnosis = s.is_primary_diagnosis WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (icd_hcc_key, condition_code, condition_code_type, condition_effective_year, hcc_code, hcc_model_version, hcc_model_type, hcc_effective_year, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, is_primary_diagnosis) VALUES (s.icd_hcc_key, s.condition_code, s.condition_code_type, s.condition_effective_year, s.hcc_code, s.hcc_model_version, s.hcc_model_type, s.hcc_effective_year, s.effective_start_date, s.effective_end_date, s.is_primary_diagnosis)
